authorization: Demande explicite de Lou de placer les visages des animateurs sur des personnages fantastiques, limitée aux cartes de l'accueil.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: full-art fantasy character illustration for a premium collectible card on the Sandbox website. This image is explicitly an imaginative costume illustration, not a real event.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact facial identity reference. The person must remain unmistakably the very same person.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve the photographed face faithfully, exact facial proportions, eye shape and colour, nose, mouth, jaw, beard and stubble pattern, age, realistic skin texture, hairstyle, hairline and head pose. Preserve the natural expression and direct gaze of the input. Do not beautify, smooth, idealise, make younger, change ethnicity, enlarge eyes, or reshape the face. Retain the matte black headphones to preserve the recognisable head silhouette; they can sit naturally with the fantasy outfit. Remove the microphone and the original studio entirely. Change only the clothing and body below the neck and the environment. Match believable head/body proportions.
Output is a vertical 3:4 richly detailed cinematic fantasy character portrait, from head to upper thighs, with a strong clear central silhouette and generous surrounding world detail. The real photographic face is the anchor, beautifully integrated into realistically lit costume and environment. Face must remain clearly visible and unobscured. Head near upper quarter, looking at camera at the same angle as reference. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no card frame. This is the illustration only; the website adds the frame.
Art direction: exceptional blockbuster fantasy key art, photorealistic materials and skin, ambitious magical world-building, rich cinematic colour, crisp detail, spectacular but controlled light, premium collectible full-art finish, not a cartoon or generic AI headshot.
Transform the body and world into a heroic architect of playful worlds. He wears finely crafted silver and deep teal explorer armour over textured dark fabric, elegant and inventive rather than warlike. His hands arrange floating luminous geometric world fragments, as if building a fantastic quest landscape: tiny islands, stone stairways, trees and bridges levitate around a beautiful cyan crystal at waist height. A magnificent impossible floating citadel and waterfalls rise behind him, cyan starlight and warm dawn through the clouds. Include subtle six-sided geometric objects suggesting tabletop play, with no markings or writing. The real face remains the exact photographed Lou. Cyan is the dominant magical accent with silver and restrained warm gold. Do not place anything in front of his face.
